name: Tsuuya
source:
Older Tsuuya from [url=/v3988]Sora o Aogite Kumo Takaku[/url]. After breaking the bond with Bordeaux, Tsuuya is now an Unpaired Dragon. She does missions while searching for her real partner.

[spoiler]After helping Marin and surving a fall from a cliff working together,  Tsuuya and Marin become partners[/spoiler]
